function.name: come_here
function.description: Walk to the player who is speaking to you, once.

function.name: follow
function.description: Keep walking after a player until told to stop.

player.description: Their name; leave it out for the one speaking to you

function.name: stop
function.description: Stop what you are doing and stand still.

function.name: hunt
function.description: Hunt mobs with your best weapon and pick up what they drop. If you see none, you go out looking for them.

mob.description: The mob, as Minecraft names it: cow, pig, sheep, chicken, zombie...; several separated by commas (cow,pig) for the nearest of any

count.description: How many to kill, 1 to 8; 8 when the person did not say; 0 for every one you find; you stop by yourself once a search for more finds none

toward.description: Which way to go looking if you see none: north, south, east or west; the way you face when not said

function.name: clear
function.description: Break every block in a box, top layer first, with your best tools.

function.name: status
function.description: Your health, food, what you are doing and what you carry.

function.name: look_around
function.description: Who and what is near you: players, mobs, things lying on the ground.
